title: Neutral-prompt replication: does contagion require the 'swayed by majority' prompt?

notes: Codex audit: 'The regular agent is explicitly told it relies heavily on peers.'
This experiment runs the same setup with neutral honest-agent prompts.
If contagion persists with neutral prompts, the finding is robust.
If it disappears, the effect is prompted, not emergent.
Both rosters use same liars (contamination_agent, do not waver).
Only honest agents differ: specialist+regular vs neutral+neutral.
